description:
Update crown profile metadata via PUT /api/v2/registration/{id}/profile?chain={chain}. Requires a session bound to a backend JWT (run authenticate first) and the session wallet must own or manage the crown on that chain.

Params: crown_id (string), chain (string; required, a token id names a different crown on every chain), description (string?), tags (string[]?), category ('meme'|'gaming'|'defi'|'nft'|'social'|'utility'?) [NOT FORWARDED — no backend route exposes category on the profile endpoint], website (string?), socials ({twitter?, telegram?, discord?}?), logo_url (string?), session_token (string)
Returns: {updated_fields: string[]}
Errors: NO_SESSION, SESSION_EXPIRED, NO_JWT, NOT_OWNER, NO_FIELDS, API_ERROR

category.description: Project category. ACCEPTED but NOT forwarded — the profile endpoint does not expose this field today; the input is preserved here for API stability.

chain.description: Chain of the crown (e.g. 'base', 'arbitrum', 'solana'). Required: a token id names a different crown on every chain, and the role check and write happen on this one.

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate (must have been issued post-JWT-bridge, i.e. after fix/mcp-siwe-jwt-bridge)

socials.description: Social links: {twitter, telegram, discord}. twitter maps to the backend `xdotcom` field.

name: update_profile
title: Update token page profile
